candidate_binding: Containing Git commit pins these artifacts. A later evidence-only commit may name its verified implementation parent; no self-referential SHA is claimed.

human_acceptance.scope: Human review of this architecture task; does not assert separate model review, completed checks, master integration or Schema authorization.

minimum_work_unit_output.work_performed_or_requested: 建立七领域、四十四概念实体及五十九二元关系，修订存档身份和长期历史合同，完成五份业务架构候选文档与 Schema 输入边界。
minimum_work_unit_output.implementation_or_review_method: 以当前精确 master 源码核实 DEV14 技术身份和原生候选限制，结合固定输入的六个正反例及机器字典、ER、引用和范围检查，使用 OS managed runner 绑定干净提交验证。
minimum_work_unit_output.supportability_rationale: reset 源码实际重建 save_instance_id 与 generation_id，因此独立稳定 world_id 具有不同业务含义；同世界复合引用、来源断言修订与字段白名单分别支持隔离、历史和隐藏 Potential 边界。
minimum_work_unit_output.feasibility_rationale: 模型只规定逻辑身份、关系和有效性约束；SQLite 的复合键与外键可承载其约束方向，物理库数、DDL、事务及迁移留待 Schema 任务，原生未知映射保持 HOLD。

verification_evidence.limits: Proves only declared OS static and conceptual checks; no independent model or native acceptance.

minimum_work_unit_output.residual_risk_or_unproved_limits: 概念示例不证明生产 API 安全、真实游戏回读、长期赛季 Decoder、数据库迁移或独立模型审核。GameID、PlayerID 与 StatBank 边界待 NATIVE-ACCEPT-01。

publication_binding.exact_published_sha: Use containing published Git commit; final Human handoff and external publication_receipt.json record its full SHA after push/readback.
publication_binding.final_managed_attempt: Sibling workspace directory world-data-arch-01-evidence/final-attempt; final committed tree is revalidated before publication.
